algorithm_baseline.classification: room placement followed by placement-order L corridors and depth-first maze fill
algorithm_baseline.room_extent: odd width and height selected from [3,7], clipped by the maze interior
algorithm_baseline.room_position: odd local coordinates with a one-cell outer boundary
algorithm_baseline.overlap: strict rectangle intersection; touching edges are accepted
algorithm_baseline.corridors: consecutive accepted room centers joined by an RNG-selected horizontal-first or vertical-first L bend
algorithm_baseline.fill: iterative depth-first carving starts at local (1,1) and preserves previously opened room/corridor cells
algorithm_baseline.step_unit: one room attempt, DFS loop iteration, or corridor raster cell
algorithm_baseline.materialization_poll: one cancellation poll per blocked output cell

translation.result: equal local blocked rasters and equal consumed steps after translating every queried cell
translation.hash_note: maze_hash includes origin metadata and therefore is not translation invariant

topology.logical_cells: all odd/odd logical cells are open
topology.connectivity: all logical cells are mutually reachable
topology.cycles: room interiors add edges; the result is connected but not a perfect maze

public_surface.room_t: declared only by maze_room_blend.h; no repository consumer found
